from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
import json
from typing import Optional


@dataclass
class OrderRecord:
    order_id: str
    status: str = "pending"
    in_flight: bool = False
    pending_retry: bool = False
    settled_at: Optional[str] = None
    retries: int = 0


def submit_order(order: OrderRecord) -> None:
    if order.status == "pending":
        order.status = "running"
    if order.retries >= 3:
        order.status = "failed"


def cancel_order(order: OrderRecord) -> None:
    if order.status == "running":
        order.status = "cancelled"


def complete_order(order: OrderRecord) -> None:
    if order.status == "running":
        order.status = "completed"
    if order.retries >= 5:
        order.status = "dead"


def save_order(path: Path, order: OrderRecord) -> None:
    payload = {
        "order_id": order.order_id,
        "status": order.status,
        "lease_token": "tok-1",
    }
    path.write_text(json.dumps(payload))


def load_order(path: Path) -> dict:
    data = json.loads(path.read_text())
    return {
        "order_id": data["order_id"],
        "status": data["status"],
    }


def infer_order_phase(base_dir: Path) -> str:
    if (base_dir / "order_lock.flag").exists():
        return "locked"
    if (base_dir / "order_checkpoint.json").exists():
        return "resuming"
    if (base_dir / "order_done.marker").exists():
        return "done"
    return "idle"
